page_title: Xmind - Mind Map Maker & AI Brainstorming Tool

sources.entry: Lighten - The best way to clarify thinking, boost productivity, brainstorm, and visualize concepts.

summary.name: Xmind
summary.one_liner: Xmind is a mind mapping and brainstorming tool, available on web, desktop, and mobile, with an AI assistant (Xmind Agent) that builds and expands maps from text, files, or links.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Xmind Agent, an AI assistant that creates a structured mind map from a sentence, file, link, or conversation and lets the user keep developing it through chat. Maps can be turned into project plans with an enhanced Gantt chart using working days, and users can switch between structures such as mind maps, timelines, matrices, and Zones. It offers real-time collaboration, shared team spaces, and sync across devices. Export or print is mentioned, along with presentation and ZEN focus modes. The page also lists security points such as local file storage and ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2 Type II infrastructure.
notable: Xmind Agent AI assistant that builds and expands mind maps through chat
Enhanced Gantt chart with working-day planning
Multiple structures: mind map, timeline, matrix, Zones
Files stored locally, with optional AWS sync
caveats: Some features, including the free eBook and Why Xmind Rocks 2.0, are tied to a Premium upgrade
Pricing tiers beyond the Premium mention are not detailed on the page
